v2 card: data.extensions exists WITHOUT hooks, so root-level extensions hooks are not looked at
a top-level `hooks` list is read off ANY card's raw, not only lorecards
blank hook strings and non-string codes are not counted
system_prompt/post_history_instructions are blanked but do not make a world card
both directives present: directives=2, raw keys removed
an unclosed `<%` strips to end of text (counted once)
EJS in alternate_greetings (raw), entry titles and keys is NOT stripped
`[Initial Variables]` title counts as a variable declaration
`@@initial_variables` decorator counts as a declaration
the declaration marker may sit in `name` when title/comment are absent
`secret: true` entries are world machinery (counted, dropped from the half)
`extensions.secret` is NOT counted by the split, but the player import drops it
constant survives a keeper world import, forced off on a player import
